review_candidates.description: Descripción de la empresa Grupo ecsico es una empresa dedicada a la gestión y análisis de información ambiental para apoyar la toma de decisiones en proyectos públicos y privados. Trabajamos con bases de datos especializadas y herramientas tecnológicas para garantizar la calidad, trazabilidad y disponibilidad de los datos ambientales. Nuestro objetivo es facilitar el cumplimiento normativo y la evaluación de impacto mediante información fiable y actualizada. Fomentamos un entorno de trabajo colaborativo, con oportunidades de aprendizaje continuo y participación en proyectos relevantes. Buscamos personas con iniciativa y ganas de aportar valor en la gestión de datos y la protección del entorno. Descripción del puesto Como Administrador de Bases de Datos Ambientales, te encargarás de gestionar, mantener y optimizar las bases de datos que almacenan información ambiental crítica de la empresa. En tu día a día, diseñarás estructuras de datos, crearás y revisarás procedimientos de carga, transformación y validación de información, y garantizarás la integridad y seguridad de los datos. También supervisarás procesos de copia de seguridad y recuperación, gestionarás la replicación entre servidores y realizarás tareas de monitorización y ajuste de rendimiento. Colaborarás con equipos técnicos y especialistas ambientales para definir requisitos, mejorar los modelos de datos y resolver incidencias relacionadas con el acceso y la calidad de la información. Este es un puesto de jornada completa, de carácter presencial, ubicado en Villahermosa, TAB. Requisitos Aptitudes en administración de bases de datos y gestión de bases de datos (Database Administration, Databases) para asegurar su disponibilidad, seguridad y rendimiento. Aptitudes en diseño de bases de datos (Database Design) para crear estructuras eficientes y coherentes con las necesidades ambientales y operativas. Aptitudes en resolución de problemas (Troubleshooting) para identificar y solucionar incidencias técnicas relacionadas con accesos, rendimiento y consistencia de los datos. Aptitudes en replicación de datos (Replication) para gestionar entornos distribuidos, sincronización entre servidores y planes de contingencia. Formación en informática, ingeniería, ciencias ambientales o campo relacionado, y experiencia previa trabajando con sistemas de gestión de bases de datos (p.ej. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle). Conocimiento de herramientas de integración y análisis de datos, nociones de normativa ambiental aplicable y capacidad para documentar procesos de forma clara. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, atención al detalle, organización del trabajo y disposición para aprender nuevas tecnologías y metodologías de gestión de datos.

review_candidates.title: (Remote) Director Research & Development
review_candidates.description: Harris; is seeking a Director Research & Development This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 1-2 trips per year to South Korea. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into South Korea. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in Korean Standard Time timezone. This role requires Bilingual English and Korean. Salary 100K - 140K AI & Innovation Mindset We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards. What Your Impact Will Be Provide technical direction and guidance for all product development and support services needed throughout the organization. Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to assess the effectiveness and impact of R&D initiatives and provide regular reports and updates to senior management. Own the technology roadmap that outlines the strategic direction for product development. Manage the allocation of resources, including budget, personnel, and infrastructure. Manage, mentor and coach R&D team members. Lead end-to-end project management activities across the team, from planning through delivery. Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies. Own R&D planning, execution tracking, risk management, and status reporting. Act as the primary interface the R&D team and the executive leadership team. Provide input on the R&D strategies, goals and objectives to align with business priorities and drive innovation in software development. Collaborate with the executive team on the financial operations of the department, including budgeting, forecasting, and ensuring a positive return on investment. What We Are Looking For Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent work experience. 10+ years of experience in software development. 5+ years of experience in project or program management. 3+ years of experience in a leadership or management role. Bilingual English and Korean. Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously. Demonstrated experience managing people and leading cross-functional team. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to balance delivery accountability with people leadership responsibilities. Flexibility to travel for on-site visits to the R&D office as needed. What We Can Offer 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs Lifestyle rewards Remote work and more! About Harris Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

Strong content creation, communication, and project management skills. Experience working closely with Sales and Business Development teams. Strong understanding of marketing funnels, conversion rates, and campaign performance. Experience with CRM (Hubspot) and marketing automation tools. Strong analytical and commercial mindset. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. USA /Europe markets experience is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Winirix | Outsourcing & BPO is an Egypt-based outsourcing and offshoring consulting company that helps businesses scale by delegating time-consuming, repeatable operational tasks to trained offshore teams. The company partners with business owners who want to focus on strategic growth while Winirix manages day-to-day execution. Winirix builds people-first outsourcing models and simple, well-structured processes that provide consistent, measurable results. Its approach is grounded in trust, transparency, and performance, acting as an extension of client teams and aligning with their goals. Every outsourcing partnership is designed for long-term collaboration, with simplicity driving effective outcomes. Role Description The Quality Assurance Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This role is responsible for monitoring and evaluating operational processes to ensure service quality, compliance with internal standards, and alignment with client requirements. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing workflows and documentation, performing regular audits on deliverables, identifying process gaps, and recommending corrective and preventive actions. The specialist will collaborate with team leaders to implement quality guidelines, train staff on best practices, and track performance metrics to support continuous improvement. The role also involves preparing quality reports, supporting client reviews, and contributing to the development of standardized procedures that enhance efficiency and consistency across projects. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Quality Assurance and Quality Control to review processes, validate outputs, and ensure adherence to defined standards. Candidates should possess skills in Quality Management and Quality Auditing to design quality frameworks, conduct audits, and monitor compliance across teams and projects. Candidates should possess knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) or similar structured compliance frameworks, and be able to apply these principles to service and process environments. Relevant experience in outsourcing, BPO, operations, or process-driven environments, with a focus on continuous improvement and performance measurement. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and recommend practical improvements. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to document procedures and present audit findings clearly. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, manage multiple tasks, and maintain attention to detail under time constraints. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Quality Management, Engineering, or a related field; relevant quality certifications are an advantage (Not Mandatory).
